levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Assigns a rating to a zone without naming any specific item found there.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names at least three specific items to support the rating for all three zones.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names specific items for all three zones and notices a pattern across zones, such as the same type of clutter showing up in more than one place.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Gives a vague or generic reason, such as "it's better," for why space care matters.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Gives one specific reason for self and one specific, different reason for someone else who shares the home.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Gives both specific reasons and connects them to the specific past incident described in the reflection.

lookFors: The reflection response names a specific incident from the past week, not a general statement.
Ratings are supported by named items rather than a rating word alone.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
